examples.zh: 几乎没有什么可继续进行的，我们只能猜测发生过的事。

examples.en: The project was masterminded by Morris, then aged 29.
examples.zh: 这个项目由时年29岁的莫里斯策划。

examples.en: Ridley, as commerce secretary, masterminded the privatisation.
examples.zh: 时任商务部长的里德利策划推行了私有化。

examples.en: He could unravel a knot that others wouldn't even attempt.
examples.zh: 他能解开其他人甚至不敢尝试的绳结。

examples.en: ideas that he was to enunciate decades later
examples.zh: 他将于数十年后清晰阐述的想法

examples.en: I'll be happy to reimburse you for any expenses you've had.
examples.zh: 我很乐意报销你的所有花费。

senses.meaning: 偿还, 补偿, 付报酬

examples.en: Because my left eye is so weak, my right eye has to work harder to compensate.
examples.zh: 因为我左眼视力差，右眼就要辛苦点来弥补一下。

examples.en: We outstripped all our competitors in sales last year.
examples.zh: 去年我们的销售额超过了所有竞争对手。

examples.en: “Please don’t gibe me,” Lydia said.
examples.zh: “请不要嘲笑我，”利迪娅说。

examples.en: At the gate of the Exhibition, Mr. Khrushchev voiced a gibe about the United States ban on the shipment of strategic goods to the Soviet Union.
examples.zh: 在展览馆大门口，赫鲁晓夫先生以嘲弄的口气抗议美国针对苏联的战略物资禁运。

senses.meaning: 嘲笑, 骗, 挫败, 嘲弄

examples.en: Opposition MPs mocked the government’s decision.
examples.zh: 反对党议员讥笑政府的这一决策。

examples.en: ‘Running away?’ he mocked.
examples.zh: “想逃跑？”他取笑道。

examples.en: It’s easy for you to mock, but we put a lot of work into this play.
examples.zh: 你讲风凉话是很轻松，但我们这出戏可是费了很大力气的。

examples.en: ‘Somewhere,’ he mused, ‘I’ve heard your name before.’
examples.zh: “我以前在哪里，”他沉思着说，“听说过你的名字。”

examples.en: He continued to ponder the problem as he walked home.
examples.zh: 他一边往家走一边继续思考那个问题。

examples.en: ...a public statement avowing neutrality.
examples.zh: ...一份宣布中立的公开声明。

senses.meaning: 承认, 同意, [民法]确认, 批准

examples.en: ‘Edward, you are naughty,’ Dorothy chided.
examples.zh: “爱德华，你真顽皮。”多萝西斥责道。

senses.meaning: 冲淡, 变淡, 变弱, 稀释

examples.en: diluted fruit juice
examples.zh: 稀释的果汁

examples.en: the glutted property market
examples.zh: 已经饱和的房地产市场

examples.en: The light of the setting sun suffused the clouds.
examples.zh: 落日的霞光映红了云层。

examples.en: Hot colour suffused her cheeks.
examples.zh: 她的脸涨得又红又烫。

senses.meaning: 崇拜, 爱慕, (口语)喜爱

examples.en: Betty adores her grandchildren.
examples.zh: 贝蒂非常宠爱孙辈。

examples.en: a symbol of Arab courage, to be venerated for generations
examples.zh: 受到世代尊崇的阿拉伯人勇气的象征

examples.en: You will be remunerated and so will your staff.
examples.zh: 你将会得到报酬，你的员工也会。

senses.meaning: 初次公演, 初演主角

examples.en: The documentary premiered at the Jerusalem Film Festival.
examples.zh: 那部记录片在耶路撒冷电影节上首映。

senses.meaning: 除去盐分, 淡化海水

examples.en: families who hoarded food during the strike
examples.zh: 罢工期间囤积食品的家庭

examples.en: Women feel professionally penalized for taking time off to raise children.
examples.zh: 女性认为休假带孩子在职业上对自己不利。

examples.en: his much touted musical
examples.zh: 他那出备受推崇的音乐剧

examples.en: The scent of climbing roses wafts through the window.
examples.zh: 蔷薇的香味随风从窗户飘进来。

examples.en: The Michelin Awards are coveted by restaurants all over the world.
examples.zh: 米其林评级是全世界所有餐厅的渴望。

examples.en: What reason vamoose is people can'ts help wanting to ask him after all this factory?…
examples.zh: 人们不禁要问他究竟是什么原因匆匆离开这个厂？

senses.meaning: 窜改, 添写进去, 插入新语句

examples.en: He started humming a tune, then interpolated the odd word as though having difficulty remembering.
examples.zh: 他开始哼起一个曲调，尽管记得不太清楚，他又插入了几个词。

senses.meaning: 篡夺, 篡位, 侵占

examples.en: There were a couple of attempts to usurp the young king.
examples.zh: 屡次有人企图篡夺那位年轻国王的王位。

senses.meaning: 催促, 赶紧, 促进, 加速

examples.en: Their departure was hastened by an abnormally cold winter.
examples.zh: 那个冬天异常寒冷，所以他们提前走了。

senses.meaning: 挫败, 阻挠, 使感到灰心, 阻止

examples.en: Their attempts to speak to him were frustrated by the guards.
examples.zh: 他们想跟他说话，但被警卫拦住了。

examples.en: She spends hours primping in front of the mirror.
examples.zh: 她总是花很长时间在镜子前梳妆打扮。

senses.meaning: 打扮, 装饰, 化妆
打嗝, (火山、炮等)冒烟、喷出

examples.en: a line of chimneys belching out smoke
examples.zh: 喷吐着浓烟的一排烟囱

examples.en: Overly proud people refuse to admit their mistakes — and sometimes even deny the fact that they make them — because they feel that it would impugn their image.
examples.zh: 过于自负的人拒绝承认自己的错误 — 甚至有时候否认自己制造错误的事实 — 因为他们感觉那将会打击到自己的形象。

examples.en: A broken rib had perforated her lung.
examples.zh: 一根肋骨骨折，刺穿了她的肺部。

senses.meaning: 打扫, 以(腐肉)为食, 从废物中提取

examples.en: Pigs scavenged among the rubbish.
examples.zh: 猪在垃圾堆里觅食。

senses.meaning: 大步走(过), 跨过, 大步行走

examples.en: They were joined by a newcomer who came striding across a field.
examples.zh: 他们中又来了个新人，那人穿过一块田地大步走过来。

examples.en: God, said, ‘Let the waters teem with countless living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth across the vault of heaven.
examples.zh: 上帝说：“水中要有万种游鱼，地上要有无数飞鸟”于是上帝创造出种类繁多的大小鱼类及飞鸟。

examples.en: ...pests like aphids which infest cereal crops.
examples.zh: …像蚜虫那样大肆侵害谷类作物的害虫。

senses.meaning: 大声叫, 大叫, 喊叫

examples.en: It is for psychologists to debate how far this method is likely to conduce to a better grasp of things.
examples.zh: 关于这种体罚方式能在多大程度上引导小孩对事物有更好的认识，这个问题可以留给心理学家去讨论。

examples.en: Mash the bananas.
examples.zh: 把香蕉捣烂。

senses.meaning: 到处翻寻, 搜出, 检查

examples.en: They rummage through piles of secondhand clothes for something that fits.
examples.zh: 他们在成堆的二手衣服中翻找合身的衣服。

examples.en: The staff were pilfering behind the bar.
examples.zh: 工作人员在吧台后面偷东西。

examples.en: Then saith he unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful, even unto death: tarry ye here, and watch with me.
examples.zh: 便对他们说，我心里甚是忧伤，几乎要死。 你们在这里等候，和我一同儆醒。

senses.meaning: 低垂, 凋萎, 萎靡

examples.en: The plant needs some water – it’s starting to droop.
examples.zh: 这株植物需要浇些水——它开始打蔫了。

examples.en: His eyelids began to droop (= close, because he was sleepy ) .
examples.zh: 他的眼皮开始耷拉下来了。

examples.en: Jessie drooped her head.
examples.zh: 杰茜垂下头。

senses.meaning: 低声歌唱, 低声哼, 低吟

examples.en: He would much rather have been crooning in a smoky bar.
examples.zh: 他宁愿是在充满烟气的酒吧里低声哼唱。

examples.en: A tear trickled down the old man's cheek.
examples.zh: 一滴泪水顺着老人的面颊流了下来。

examples.en: Blood from the wound dribbled down the side of his face.
examples.zh: 伤口的血顺着他脸颊流下来。

examples.en: He upended the beer, and swallowed.
examples.zh: 他把啤酒倒出来，大口喝了。

examples.en: The petrol tank suddenly ignited.
examples.zh: 油箱突然着火了。

examples.en: The candle ignited the plastic.
examples.zh: 蜡烛烧着了塑料。

examples.en: a scandal that sullied his reputation
examples.zh: 玷污了他名誉的丑闻

examples.en: carved wooden chairs
examples.zh: 木雕椅子

examples.en: An artist sculpted a full-size replica of her head.
examples.zh: 一位艺术家雕塑了一尊她头部的全幅头像。

senses.meaning: 跌跌撞撞地走, 犯大错, 做错

examples.en: They blundered badly when they gave him the job.
examples.zh: 他们犯了大错，让他做这份工作。

examples.en: Patrick sat gazing into space (= looking straight in front, not at any particular person or thing ).
examples.zh: 帕特里克坐着，茫然地看着前方。

phrases.zh: ◎【纹章学】(鹿或类似鹿的动物)从旁看去似在盯着人看的，侧身正视的

examples.en: Dormice hibernate from October to May.
examples.zh: 睡鼠从10月到5月冬眠。

senses.meaning: 逗留, 闲荡, 拖延, 游移

examples.en: I spent a week at Kandersteg and could happily have lingered on.
examples.zh: 我在坎德施泰格逗留了一个星期，本来还可以开开心心地多待几天。

phrases.zh: 在…上拖延；细细思考；仔细欣赏；慢吞吞地做某事

examples.en: These groups must renounce violence if there is to be progress towards peace.
examples.zh: 若要迈向和平，这些组织就必须放弃使用暴力。

examples.en: Young people renounced capitalism in favour of peace and love.
examples.zh: 年轻人提倡和平和友爱，摒弃资本主义。

examples.en: French cooking, she asserted, is the best in the world.
examples.zh: 她坚称法国菜是世界上最好的。

phrases.zh: 坚持自己的权利或意见

examples.en: We squatted beside the pool and watched the diver sink slowly down.
examples.zh: 我们蹲在池边，看潜水员慢慢沉下水。

examples.en: He eluded his pursuers by escaping into a river.
examples.zh: 他逃到河里，甩掉了追踪他的人。

examples.en: policies which are throttling many Asian economies
examples.zh: 抑制许多亚洲国家经济发展的政策

phrases.zh: adv. 以最高速度；油门大开地
节流操纵；节流控制；推力调节
手油门；手节气门；手风门

examples.en: It stinks in here!
examples.zh: 这里很臭！

examples.en: The toilets stank to high heaven (= stank very much ) .
examples.zh: 那些厕所臭气熏天。

phrases.zh: 发恶臭；散发出…的气味；[口]含有…的迹象（尤指不良的）

senses.meaning: 发出火花, 闪耀光芒
发火花, (使)闪耀, (香槟酒等)发泡, 用眼神表达, 发光闪烁

examples.en: The sea sparkled in the sun.
examples.zh: 阳光下大海碧波闪耀。

examples.en: The crystal chandelier sparkled.
examples.zh: 那水晶枝形吊灯闪闪发光。

examples.en: I flip through my favorite papers and magazines, the images as crisp as in print, without a maddening wait for each page to load.
examples.zh: 我浏览着我喜爱的报纸和杂志，图片犹如印刷的一般明亮清晰，每一页的载入没有出现令人发狂的等待。

examples.en: While that brings greater efficiency to the process for employers, it can be awfully maddening for job seekers.
examples.zh: 虽然这样给雇主带来了很高的效率，但是对求职者来说却可能是让人发狂的痛苦过程。

senses.meaning: 发明, 设计, 图谋

examples.en: In 1862, a technique was contrived to take a series of photographs showing stages of movement.
examples.zh: 1862年时发明了一种技术，可以拍出一连串展示连续动作的照片。

senses.meaning: 发芽, 发育, 使生长

examples.en: Some seed varieties germinate fast, so check every day or so.
examples.zh: 有一些品种的种子发芽快，所以差不多每天都要察看一下。

senses.meaning: 繁殖, 传播, 宣传

examples.en: The group launched a website to propagate its ideas .
examples.zh: 这个团体建了一个网站来宣扬他们的主张。

senses.meaning: 反驳, 反击, 回报

examples.en: ‘It’s all your fault!’ he retorted.
examples.zh: “那都是你的错！”他反驳道。

examples.en: I do not want my son learning how to be a disgusting pervert from these men and seeing this behaviour as normal.
examples.zh: 我不希望我的儿子向这些变态的男人学习，并且认为这是一种十分正常的行为。

examples.en: In the past, every pervert believed thathe was the only one who had an abstruse desire. Today, he can find out on theInternet that there's someone like him in New Zealand or Patagonia.
examples.zh: 在过去，每个性反常者都认为自己是唯一一个有难解欲望的人，但是现在，他能够在网上发现，在新西兰或者巴塔哥尼亚有一个和他一样的人。

examples.en: One is to see whether you have any worry triggers and to distract yourself when you begin to ruminate.
examples.zh: 首先看看你自己是否有担忧的动机，如果当你自己出现“沉思”时，尽量分散自己的注意力。

examples.en: “Some people prone to ruminate have basic problems pushing things out of consciousness once they get there,” she said.
examples.zh: 有些人陷入事情中时，倾向于反刍基本问题来把事情驱逐出脑海。

examples.en: This is in part because real events can affect us in the real world, and in part because we tend to ruminate about the implications of real-world acts.
examples.zh: 原因部分是由于真实事件影响着现实世界中的我们，部分是因为我们倾向反复思考现实世界中行为的影响。

senses.meaning: 反抗, 起义, 反叛, 反感, 厌恶

examples.en: He was revolted by the smell.
examples.zh: 那气味让他恶心。

senses.meaning: 反射, 反映, 表现, 反省, 细想

examples.en: The drop in consumer spending reflects concern about the economy.
examples.zh: 消费支出的下降反映出人们对经济的担忧。

phrases.zh: 仔细考虑，思考；反省；回想，回顾；怀疑

examples.en: Day in and day out, the flat crack of the tank guns reverberates through the little Bavarian town.
examples.zh: 日复一日地，单调的坦克炮的轰隆声在巴伐利亚的这个小镇上空回响着。

senses.meaning: 反责, 反唇相讥, 反控诉

examples.en: Who could have perpetrated such a dreadful crime?
examples.zh: 谁会犯下如此可怕的罪行？

examples.en: We do not ask others to be faultless , we only ask their faults should not incommode to our own .
examples.zh: 我们不要求他人完美无缺，我们只要求他们的缺陷不会妨碍我们。

examples.en: She tried to run, but was hampered by her heavy suitcase.
examples.zh: 她想跑，但沉重的旅行箱拖累了她。

examples.en: An attempt to rescue the men has been hampered by bad weather.
examples.zh: 对那几名男子的营救行动受到恶劣天气的阻碍。

senses.meaning: 放牧, 吃草, 擦伤, 擦过

examples.en: I fell on the gravel, severely grazing my knee.
examples.zh: 我摔倒在砾石路上，膝盖擦伤得很严重。

examples.en: She waived her right to a lawyer.
examples.zh: 她放弃了请律师的权利。

examples.en: No one wants to relinquish power once they have it.
examples.zh: 人一旦有了权就不想放弃。

examples.en: White House officials ordered Williams to recant.
examples.zh: 白宫官员命令威廉斯公开宣布放弃自己的观点。

senses.meaning: 放弃, 弃权, 拒绝

examples.en: The sky was streaked yellow and purple.
examples.zh: 天空被染成一条一条的黄色和紫色。

phrases.zh: 超快扫描照相机；超高速扫描摄影机

examples.en: She had seen herself repeatedly maligned in the newspapers.
examples.zh: 她看到自己在报纸上一再受到诽谤。

examples.en: a much maligned politician
examples.zh: 一个备受中伤的政治家

examples.en: Sgt. Norwood complained that the article defamed him.
examples.zh: 诺维德中士抱怨这篇文章诽谤他。

examples.en: The governor does not have the authority to rescind the ruling.
examples.zh: 该州长无权撤销这项裁决。

senses.meaning: 废除, 取消, 废止

examples.en: Their marriage was annulled last year.
examples.zh: 他们的婚姻关系去年宣告解除。

senses.meaning: 废止, 撤销, 否定, 放弃, 废除

examples.en: The government has just repealed the law segregating public facilities.
examples.zh: 政府刚刚废除了隔离公共设施的法令。

examples.en: a partially decomposed body
examples.zh: 部分腐烂的尸体

examples.en: There's little advantage to amortizing the loan, especially on a 30 or 40-year basis.
examples.zh: 分期偿还这项贷款没有什么好处，尤其是按30或40年偿还。

examples.en: At this location the two roads divaricate.
examples.zh: 两路在此地点分开。

examples.en: Fruiting pedicels slender or thickened and nearly as wide as fruit, erect, ascending, divaricate , or reflexed.
examples.zh: 纤细的或加厚和差不多作为宽作为果，直立，上升，极叉开，或反折的果梗。

examples.en: Paul resented the fact that Carol didn’t trust him.
examples.zh: 保罗非常气愤，因为卡萝尔不信任他。

examples.en: Mary is stitching a bedspread.
examples.zh: 玛丽在缝床罩。

phrases.zh: 针距；线圈长度；针迹长度

examples.en: No one dared to gainsay him.
examples.zh: 没有人敢反驳他。

examples.en: She fondled his neck.
examples.zh: 她抚摸着他的脖子。

examples.en: The Home Office have resurrected plans to build a new prison just outside London.
examples.zh: 内政部重新提出了在伦敦市外建一座监狱的计划。

examples.en: another failed attempt to resurrect his career
examples.zh: 他重振事业的又一次失败尝试

examples.en: programmes to help demobilized soldiers fit into civilian life
examples.zh: 帮助复员军人适应平民生活的方案

examples.en: Winston proposed several ways for the industry to recuperate.
examples.zh: 温斯顿为复兴这个行业提出了几种办法。

examples.en: There is a need for further research to replicate these findings.
examples.zh: 需要进一步的研究来验证这些结果。

senses.meaning: 嘎扎嘎扎的咬嚼, 压碎, 扎扎地踏过

examples.en: She sucked an ice cube into her mouth, and crunched it loudly.
examples.zh: 她把一冰块儿含在嘴里，并嘎吱嘎吱地大声嚼起来。

phrases.zh: 信贷紧缩；信贷危机（等于credit crisis）

examples.en: Ascension long ago served to transmute karma of the consensus known as Earth so that Earth could retain her vibration.
examples.zh: 很久之前，提升就为改变地球这个一致实相的业力而服务，好让地球可留在其振动中。

examples.en: That luxury appears to be fading as power consumption has skyrocketed and the circuit boards on which the microprocessors sit threaten to transmute themselves into space heaters.
examples.zh: 但随著耗电量急遽高升，微处理器所在的电路板恐有变身为暖炉的危险，电脑产业既有的优势似乎正渐渐消逝。

examples.en: When performing taint flow analysis, the scanner models the flow of data within the system.
examples.zh: 当执行污染流分析时，检测器会在这个系统中为数据流建立模型。

examples.en: His fingers were badly lacerated by the broken glass.
examples.zh: 他的手指被碎玻璃严重割伤。

examples.en: A large detachment of police was used to segregate the two rival camps of protesters.
examples.zh: 一大队分遣警察被派来隔离两群敌对的抗议者。

examples.en: In the early 1990’s an extreme form of isolation emerged, where young Japanese people seclude themselves in their homes for months or even years at a time.
examples.zh: 早在20世纪90年代初的时候，日本出现了一种极端的孤独症状，患有此症状的日本青年人一度成年累月地把自己隔离在家中。

examples.en: an attempt to eradicate inflation
examples.zh: 为消除通货膨胀所作的努力

examples.en: This problem has now been completely eradicated.
examples.zh: 这个问题现已彻底杜绝。

examples.en: The company has consolidated its position as the country’s leading gas supplier.
examples.zh: 这家公司巩固了作为该国主要煤气供应商的地位。

examples.zh: 凯里希望教会能复兴。

examples.zh: 带着我的酒醉的灵魂向那里飞腾！

examples.zh: 那天晚上，男孩饮了许多酒但他没有醉，并没有因此而变得糊涂。

examples.zh: 人们可能会认为你有一个可怕的肠道疾病或者纤维恋物癖。

examples.zh: 不要害怕问同一个问题关于一些人谁的颜色你认为可怕，因此你才知道什么地方不应该去做。

examples.zh: 他教我剪辑和粘接胶片。

examples.zh: 当水滴数量增加，它们会汇集成细流。

examples.en: All the armed groups will be disbanded.

examples.zh: 在你看来似乎有助益的行为会被他人看作干涉。

examples.zh: 新大楼即将破土动工。

examples.zh: 工作六个月后，你将接受第一次绩效评估。

examples.zh: 现在你必须要坦白面对他们。 面对这些情形，本能的反应是“先逃避后掩盖”，想尽办法为自己开脱。

examples.zh: 他们的观点很快在欧洲传播开来。

phrases.zh: 漫反射率；漫反射系数；护散反射率

examples.en: Her findings have been widely disseminated .
examples.zh: 她的发现已广为传播。

examples.en: The boys tried not to smirk.
examples.zh: 男孩们强忍住得意的笑。

examples.en: He heavily expurgated the work in its second edition.
examples.zh: 在第二版中，他大幅删减了该作品。

senses.meaning: 删节, 削减, 精简

examples.en: glistening black hair
examples.zh: 乌黑发亮的头发

examples.en: The moon glimmered faintly through the mists.
examples.zh: 月亮透过薄雾闪烁着微光。

examples.en: The flames had singed her hair.
examples.zh: 火焰燎了她的头发。

examples.en: The walls had been blackened and scorched by fire.
examples.zh: 这些墙被大火熏黑了。

examples.en: During the riots, some of the prisoners barricaded their cells.
examples.zh: 暴动期间，有些囚犯把牢房堵了起来。

examples.en: The pub is said to be haunted by the ghost of a former landlord.
examples.zh: 据说这个酒吧里经常有一位前任房主的鬼魂出没。

examples.en: Valentino was virtually deified by legions of female fans.
examples.zh: 华伦天奴实际上被女性粉丝团神化了。

examples.en: Radioactive water had seeped into underground reservoirs.
examples.zh: 放射性水已渗入了地下蓄水池。

examples.en: Police attempts to infiltrate neo-Nazi groups were largely unsuccessful.
examples.zh: 警方想打入新纳粹团体的行动基本上不成功。

senses.meaning: 生长, 过单调乏味的生话

examples.en: He spends all his free time at home vegetating in front of the TV.
examples.zh: 他把所有的空闲时间都用来窝在家里看电视。

examples.en: Gold does not tarnish easily.
examples.zh: 黄金色泽不容易变暗。

examples.en: tarnished silver spoons
examples.zh: 发乌的银勺

examples.en: At present we're gleaning information from all sources.
examples.zh: 目前我们正从所有渠道慢慢收集信息。

examples.en: A laser is used to etch a pattern in the smooth surface of the disc.
examples.zh: 激光器用于在光盘的光滑表面刻录图案。

senses.meaning: 使(身体)康复, 使复职, 使恢复名誉, 使复原

examples.en: The Prime Minister seems to be trying to rehabilitate the former defence secretary.
examples.zh: 首相似乎在努力为前国防大臣恢复名誉。

senses.meaning: 使失掉人性, 使成兽性

examples.en: War dehumanizes people.
examples.zh: 战争使人们丧失人性。

examples.en: Stir until the ingredients are amalgamated.
examples.zh: 搅拌至配料完全混合。

examples.en: ...matters pertaining to naval district defence.
examples.zh: …与海军区域防卫有关的问题。

examples.en: I’m worried about washing that shirt in case it shrinks.
examples.zh: 我不太敢洗那件衬衫，怕它会缩水。

examples.en: The army is now empowered to operate on a shoot-to-kill basis.
examples.zh: 军队现在被授权依据“杀无赦”原则行动。

senses.meaning: 疏散, 撤出, 排泄

examples.en: They were planning to evacuate the seventy American officials still in the country.
examples.zh: 他们当时在计划将仍在那个国家的70位美国官员撤离。

examples.en: As to her own life, those good friends for years gradually estrange since she's always on the run. And there's still a void in her love life.
examples.zh: 而自己的生活也因整日奔波，多年的朋友逐渐疏远，感情也一片空白。

examples.en: Being short of honesty can both severely damage the image of the public security organs and estrange the relationship between the public security organs and the people.
examples.zh: 缺乏诚信不仅严重损害公安机关的形象，还会造成公安机关与人民群众关系的疏远与隔膜。

examples.en: “Technology does not need to estrange us from one another,” Cox said. “The physical reality comes alive with the human stories we have told there.”
examples.zh: “技术不会使我们彼此疏离，”考克斯说道，“当我们来到那些有故事的地点时，现实也就活灵活现了。”

examples.en: We shall have to explicate its basic assumptions before we can assess its implications.
examples.zh: 在我们能评估其含义以前，我们得先解释其基本假设。

examples.en: These demands are helping to stoke fears of civil war.
examples.zh: 这些要求激起了对内战的恐惧。

examples.en: He sat silently cogitating.
examples.zh: 他静坐深思。

senses.meaning: 撕, 剥, 劈, 锯, 裂开, 撕裂

examples.en: Her clothes had all been ripped.
examples.zh: 她的衣服都被撕破了。

examples.en: The sail ripped under the force of the wind.
examples.zh: 船帆被狂风刮破了。

examples.en: Impatiently, Sue ripped the letter open .
examples.zh: 休急不可待地撕开信封。

phrases.zh: ◎不要担心；别理会后果；听其自然

examples.en: ...pain that rends the heart.
examples.zh: ...撕心裂肺的疼痛。

senses.meaning: 嘶嘶作声, 用嘘声表示

examples.en: The tyres of Lenny's bike hissed over the wet pavement as he slowed down.
examples.zh: 兰尼减速时，他自行车的两个轮胎在潮湿的路面上发出嘶嘶声。

examples.en: My cat hissed when I stepped on its tail.
examples.zh: 我踩在了猫的尾巴上，于是它嘶嘶地叫了起来。

senses.meaning: 松弛, 放慢, 减弱, 减少, 减缓放慢

examples.en: The heavy rain showed no signs of slackening off.
examples.zh: 大雨没有减弱的迹象。

senses.meaning: 松弛, 下陷, 下垂, (物价)下跌, 漂流

examples.en: The branch sagged under the weight of the apples.
examples.zh: 树枝被苹果压弯了。

examples.en: The skin around my eyes is starting to sag.
examples.zh: 我眼睛周围的皮肤开始下垂了。

examples.en: a sagging roof
examples.zh: 凹陷的房顶

senses.meaning: 嗽口, (用清水)刷, 冲洗掉, 漂净

examples.en: Let me just rinse my hands.
examples.zh: 让我冲个手。

examples.en: Rinse the vegetables under a cold tap.
examples.zh: 把蔬菜放在冷水龙头下冲洗。

examples.en: Strategic policy during the War was vitiated because of a sharp division between easterners and westerners.
examples.zh: 由于“东方人”和“西方人”间的巨大分歧，战争期间的战略方针没有得到切实的执行。

examples.en: an attempt to suborn a witness
examples.zh: 收买证人的企图

senses.meaning: 缩回, 缩进, 所卷(舌等), 收回, 取消, 撤消

examples.en: He confessed to the murder but later retracted his statement.
examples.zh: 他承认谋杀，但后来又翻供了。

examples.en: The elephant population is dwindling.
examples.zh: 大象的数量在减少。

examples.en: His money had dwindled away.
examples.zh: 他的钱在逐渐变少。

examples.en: I don’t want to pry , but I need to ask you one or two questions.
examples.zh: 我不想唐突，不过我需要问你一两个问题。

senses.meaning: 探险, 探测, 探究

examples.en: Management need to explore ways of improving office security.
examples.zh: 管理层需要探讨如何加强办事处的安全措施。

examples.en: I’m going to explore the possibility of a part-time job.
examples.zh: 我要好好想想兼职工作的可能性。

examples.en: I hate dogs that slobber everywhere.
examples.zh: 我讨厌到处淌口水的狗。

phrases.zh: 并联电容器；分路电容器；旁路电容器
并联电抗器，分路电抗器；分馏力；分流扼流圈

senses.meaning: 腾出, 空出,离(职),退(位)

examples.en: Clay will vacate the position on June 19.
examples.zh: 克莱将于6月19日离职。

examples.en: At any point in the project where you don't interpose your own judgment, your people are more likely to make a mistake. So what?
examples.zh: 在项目中任何你没有提出自己看法的地方，你的手下都更容易犯错。

examples.en: What is educational expenses? Why does the government want interpose to teach the market? Of social insurance system what is forming? Why should the government intervene again?
examples.zh: 什么是教育支出？政府为什么要干预教育市场？社会保险体系的构成是什么？政府又为何要干预？

examples.en: the proffered invitation
examples.zh: 提出的邀请

examples.en: The image of a seemingly tiny dancer was superimposed on the image of the table.
examples.zh: 一个看似很小的舞蹈者的影像被叠加在了那张桌子的影像上。

examples.en: Thousands of people crammed the mall Sunday.
examples.zh: 星期天成千上万的人挤进了这家大型购物中心。

phrases.zh: 补习班；补习学校，强化学校
临时抱佛脚；填鸭式地学习；死记硬背

examples.en: They asked my father to intercede with the king on their behalf.
examples.zh: 他们请我父亲代他们向国王求情。

examples.en: It has also asked Britain and the United States to intercede.
examples.zh: 它也请了英国和美国出面调停。

examples.en: Should anyone be allowed to invoke any service?
examples.zh: 是否允许任何人调用任何服务？

examples.en: You can invoke this function from anywhere in the code.
examples.zh: 您可以在代码中的任何地方调用这个函数。

examples.en: So what do I need to do to dynamically discover and invoke the service?
examples.zh: 那么，我需要做什么才能动态地发现和调用这个服务？

examples.en: He felt suddenly faint, and his heart began to palpitate.
examples.zh: 他突然感到晕厥，心脏也开始悸动。

senses.meaning: 停止, 结束, 终止

examples.en: The court ruled that the contract must be terminated.
examples.zh: 法庭裁决该合同必须终止。

examples.en: a woman’s decision on whether or not to terminate the pregnancy
examples.zh: 女子关于是否终止妊娠的决定

examples.en: The skipper notified the coastguard of the tragedy.
examples.zh: 船长通知了海岸警卫队这一灾难。

examples.en: It was virtually impossible to synchronize our lives so as to take vacations and weekends together.
examples.zh: 为了一起度假和过周末而要让我们的生活同步几乎是不可能的。

senses.meaning: 同意, 加入, 同意

examples.en: We were trounced 13-0.
examples.zh: 我们以0比13惨败。

examples.en: He must have purloined a key from somewhere.
examples.zh: 他肯定是从哪里偷了一把钥匙。

examples.en: There was Helena eavesdropping outside the door.
examples.zh: 海伦娜当时在门外偷听。

examples.en: ...a huge round mass of smooth rock protruding from the water.
examples.zh: …从水中突出来的一块光滑的圆形巨石。

examples.en: Drivers coming in the opposite direction swerved to avoid the bodies.
examples.zh: 从反方向过来的司机们突然转向以避开这些尸体。

examples.en: soldiers’ faces daubed with black mud
examples.zh: 抹了黑泥的士兵的脸

senses.meaning: 涂上, 抹掉, 涂污, 诽谤, 抹去

examples.en: an attempt to smear the party leadership
examples.zh: 污蔑党领导的 企图

senses.meaning: 涂污, 污损(名誉等), 把(界线,视线等)弄得模糊不清, 弄污

examples.en: The street lights were blurred by the fog.
examples.zh: 街灯在迷雾的笼罩下十分昏暗。

examples.en: Many of the details in the picture are blurred.
examples.zh: 照片中的许多细节部分都模糊了。

phrases.zh: 运动模糊；动态模糊；动感模糊
高斯模糊（一种滤镜功能）

examples.en: Cars drew up to disgorge a wedding party.
examples.zh: 一辆辆轿车开过来，下来的都是参加婚宴的人。

examples.en: Extrapolating from his latest findings, he reckons about 80% of these deaths might be attributed to smoking.
examples.zh: 从他最近的发现推断，他估计大约80%的这类死亡可能归因于吸烟。

examples.en: The new resort area has boosted tourism.
examples.zh: 新的度假区促进了旅游业的发展。

examples.en: At present the moral belief crisis is the co-existence of expansibility crisis and the retrogress crisis.
examples.zh: 当前道德信仰危机是发展性危机与倒退性危机并存。

examples.en: Practice has shown that China-Japan relations will go ahead steadily once this political foundation is maintained; otherwise the relations will be undermined, become stagnant or even retrogress.
examples.zh: 实践已经证明，严守和维护这个政治基础，中日关系就能前进，就能持续稳定发展；背离和违反这个政治基础，中日关系就会受损，就会停滞甚至倒退。

examples.en: Who smile and frown, wince and hiss.
examples.zh: 他们微笑和皱眉，畏缩与嘶嘘。

examples.en: We all wince at the thought of how Xerox utterly failed to innovate on PARC's inventions, allowing Apple and Microsoft to run away with most of them.
examples.zh: 我们都退避在想到施乐如何完全的失败再帕洛阿尔托研究中心的发明，允许苹果和微软从他们这儿逃走。

examples.en: And for the leaders in Bejing to shrink and wince and draw back in the presence of these individuals and their ideas sends a clear message.
examples.zh: 北京的领导人对他们的催促显的畏畏缩缩，并不让这些人抛头露面，政府的以对理念给外界发出了一个清晰的信号。

senses.meaning: 退位, 放弃(职位,权力等)

examples.en: King Alfonso XIII abdicated in favour of his eldest son.
examples.zh: 国王阿方索十三世把王位让给了长子。

examples.en: The king was forced to abdicate the throne .
examples.zh: 国王被迫退位。

senses.meaning: 挖掘, 开凿, 挖出, 挖空

examples.en: Schliemann excavated the ancient city of Troy.
examples.zh: 谢里曼发掘出特洛伊古城。

senses.meaning: 玩弄, 戏弄, 延误

examples.en: ...the rich and famous disporting themselves in glamorous places.
examples.zh: ...明星富豪们在豪宅中自娱自乐。

examples.en: large-scale military offensives which could jeopardize the UN peace process
examples.zh: 可能会破坏联合国和平进程的大规模军事进攻

examples.en: Jane snuggled up against his shoulder.
examples.zh: 简依偎在他的肩膀上。

examples.en: Some portions of the bill may contravene state law.
examples.zh: 这项议案中的一些部分可能与州法律相抵触。

examples.en: The file was altered to falsify the evidence.
examples.zh: 文件被动了手脚，以此伪造证据。

examples.en: The strain she was under was well camouflaged by skilful make-up.
examples.zh: 巧妙的化妆很好地掩盖了她紧张的心情。

examples.en: He entrusted his cash to a business partner for investment in a series of projects.
examples.zh: 他把现款委托给一个生意合伙人投资一系列项目。

examples.en: A subcommittee was deputed to investigate the claims.
examples.zh: 一个委员会专门小组受托去核实索赔事宜。

examples.en: We condole with you on your misfortune.
examples.zh: 我们对您的不幸表示慰问。

examples.en: Kate wrote to condole with her friend on the death of her mother.
examples.zh: 凯特写信慰问友人的丧母之痛。

senses.meaning: 稳步前进, 铸造, 伪造

examples.en: Someone stole my credit card and forged my signature.
examples.zh: 有人偷了我的信用卡，并假冒我的签名。

examples.en: a forged passport
examples.zh: 假护照

examples.en: The election results were nullified because of voter fraud.
examples.zh: 由于选票造假，选举结果被宣布无效。

examples.en: She had imbibed the traditions of her family.
examples.zh: 她受到了自己家庭传统的影响。

examples.en: It will take time to assimilate all these facts.
examples.zh: 充分掌握所有这些情况需要时间。

examples.en: The allure and charm of Paris excite all who visit there.
examples.zh: 巴黎的诱惑与魅力吸引了所有到此游玩的人。

examples.en: The allure and charm of Paris captivate all who visit there.
examples.zh: 巴黎的诱惑与魅力吸引了所有到此游玩的人。

senses.meaning: 洗擦, 擦净, 使(气体)净化, 擦洗

examples.en: She was on her hands and knees scrubbing the floor.
examples.zh: 她正趴着擦地板。

examples.en: He scrubbed the dirt off his boots.
examples.zh: 他把靴子上的脏土擦掉。

examples.en: The table needs to be scrubbed clean .
examples.zh: 这桌子要擦干净。

examples.en: She leant forward to peruse the document more closely.
examples.zh: 她俯身向前，更仔细地读那份文件。

senses.meaning: 下沉, 沉淀, 平息, 减退, 衰减

examples.en: After the heavy rains, part of the road subsided.
examples.zh: 大雨过后，部分路面塌陷了。

examples.en: The law would preempt stronger local rules.
examples.zh: 该法律将预先制止更强硬的地方性法规。

examples.en: "the survival of the fittest," a slogan that virtually preempted all debate.
examples.zh: “适者生存”，一个几乎无可辩驳的口号。

senses.meaning: 闲荡, 虚度, 徘徊

examples.en: Five or six teenagers were loitering in front of the newsagent’s.
examples.zh: 五六个青少年在报摊前面游荡。

examples.en: Did you hear his frenzied tattle?
examples.zh: 你听见这疯狂的闲谈了吗？

examples.en: But does tittle-tattle really help attract more friends?
examples.zh: 但闲聊真的能吸引来更多的朋友吗？

examples.en: His conduct did not comport with his high position.
examples.zh: 他的所作所为与他的高级职务不相称。

examples.en: Milton claims that epic poetry is the highest ambition for a poet and then he goes on to explain how it is that the epic poet should comport himself.
examples.zh: 弥尔顿声称史诗就是诗人最高的理想抱负,然后他又解释到,史诗诗人该怎样表现自己。

examples.en: The answer lies, yet again, in the interplay of population and technology.
examples.zh: 原因又一次在于人口和科技的相互影响。

examples.en: The tension and interplay between the situation and its negation, produce constantly new and emergent forms of social existence.
examples.zh: 这些情形和其否定之间的张力和相互影响一直在产出崭新的和突现的社会存在形式。

examples.en: To date, most research into the interplay of exercise and anxiety has focused on the actions of various neurotransmitters or chemical messengers within the brain, like serotonin and dopamine.
examples.zh: 迄今为止，大多数有关锻炼和焦虑的相互影响的研究都集中在大脑内的各种神经递质或化学信使，如血清素、多巴胺上。

examples.en: Sing a descant on a main tune or melody.
examples.zh: 以主调或悦耳的音调唱着评论。

examples.en: Police are sifting through the evidence.
examples.zh: 警方在筛查证据。

examples.en: Schmidt continued to expound his views on economics and politics.
examples.zh: 施密特继续阐释他关于经济与政治的观点。

examples.en: Disclosure: This reporter also lives in New Haven and has heard Chua regale friends with parenting stories.
examples.zh: 揭秘：记者也住在纽海文，曾经听过蔡在餐桌上分享育儿故事。

examples.en: Here you can still enjoy Chinese and Western buffet in the fresh morning, taste tea in the vernal afternoon and regale special beefsteak in the charming night.
examples.zh: 在这里，您还可以在晨光中享用中西自助餐，在和熙的午后，品尝下午茶，在摇曳烛光中享用特色牛排。

examples.en: This is its chance to slake the insecurities built during the isolationist years of the Cultural Revolution.
examples.zh: 这是它消除文革期间那段孤立主义岁月所造成的不安全感的机会。

examples.en: Staff use the poison to exterminate moles and rabbits.
examples.zh: 员工用毒药来消灭鼹鼠和野兔。

examples.en: ...instructions on how to calibrate a thermometer.
examples.zh: …校准温度计的说明。

examples.en: How well all her garments harmonized with each other.
examples.zh: 她所有的衣服彼此配起来是多么地协调。

examples.en: Attempts to intimidate her failed.
examples.zh: 恐吓她的企图失败了。

examples.en: He also seems to be slightly blinded by the sun, causing him to squint.
examples.zh: 他似乎也被强烈的太阳光照的有点睁不开眼睛，导致有点斜视的样子。

examples.en: 'If you are one of the unfortunate people who frown or squint while they are concentrating at the screen then, over time, you will inevitably end up with frown lines,' Dr Prager, 42, said.
examples.zh: 42岁的普拉杰医生说：“如果你在电脑前专心工作时常常蹙眉或眯眼斜视的话，那么很不幸，长此以往，你的面部将不可避免地出现皱纹。”

examples.en: Her mistake was to blab about their affair.
examples.zh: 她的错误在于泄露了他们的风流韵事。

examples.en: Will you promise not to blab to Mom and Dad?
examples.zh: 你能保证不会向爸妈泄密吗？

examples.en: She'll blab it all over the school.
examples.zh: 她会在全校大肆宣扬这件事。

examples.en: They hope to revitalize the neighborhood by providing better housing.
examples.zh: 他们希望通过提供更好的住房条件使这个社区恢复活力。

examples.en: a revitalizing massage
examples.zh: 让人恢复精神的按摩

phrases.zh: 发伪誓；作伪证；违背誓言

examples.en: Many older companies are revamping their image.
examples.zh: 很多老牌公司都在更新公司形象。

examples.en: The boat was embellished with carvings in red and blue.
examples.zh: 这艘船饰有红、蓝雕刻。

senses.meaning: 羞辱, 使丢脸, 耻辱

examples.en: Her boss humiliated her in front of all her colleagues.
examples.zh: 她的老板在所有同事面前羞辱了她。

examples.en: He then recounted the story of the interview for his first job.
examples.zh: 他然后叙述了有关他第一份工作面试的故事。

examples.en: television’s failure to publicize the unemployment issue
examples.zh: 电视未能报道失业问题

examples.en: The illness had impaired his ability to think and concentrate.
examples.zh: 这种疾病损害了他的思维能力和注意力。

examples.en: The hot sun enervated her to the point of collapse.
examples.zh: 热辣辣的太阳把她晒得快要晕过去了。

examples.en: an attenuated form of the polio virus
examples.zh: 脊髓灰质炎减毒病毒

examples.en: According to traditions, the selectmen are required by law to perambulate the bounds every five years.
examples.zh: 根据传统法律要求市镇行政管理委员会成员每隔五年巡视边界一次。

examples.en: Her creativity had been squelched.
examples.zh: 她的创造力受到了压制。

senses.meaning: 呀呀学语, 喋喋不休, 作潺潺声, 泄露(秘密)

examples.en: Momma babbled on and on about how he was ruining me.
examples.zh: 妈妈喋喋不休地数说他在如何毁我。

examples.en: The tidal wave inundated vast areas of cropland.
examples.zh: 海啸淹没了大片农田。

examples.en: People often procrastinate when it comes to paperwork.
examples.zh: 遇到文书工作，人们常常会拖拖拉拉。

examples.en: Delay always breeds danger; and to protract a great design is often to ruin it.
examples.zh: 推迟经常孕育危险；拖延一个伟大的工程常常意味着毁灭它。

examples.en: To protract the suspense, he paused for a considerable period of time before telling us the result of the experiment.
examples.zh: 为了延长悬念，他在告诉我们实验结果之前停顿了相当一段时间。

examples.en: The seeds can be used whole or pulverized into flour.
examples.zh: 这些籽可以完整使用，或者磨成粉末。

examples.en: Her pleasant manner belied her true character.
examples.zh: 她讨人喜欢的举止掩饰了她真实的个性。

senses.meaning: 掩饰, 假装, 装糊涂

examples.en: This man was too injured to dissimulate well.
examples.zh: 这个男人伤得太重，不可能掩盖得住。

examples.en: Henry was not slow to dissemble when it served his purposes.
examples.zh: 形势一对他有利，亨利就马上开始隐瞒。

examples.en: She’s not ill, she’s only shamming.
examples.zh: 她没生病，只是在装病。

senses.meaning: 侥幸成功, 意外受挫

examples.en: As recently as a year ago people wondered whether M-PESA’s success was a fluke.
examples.zh: 最近一年来，人们开始产生怀疑，是否M-PESA的成功只是一种侥幸。

examples.en: A good pay package and a company car were dangled in front of her.
examples.zh: 优厚的薪酬和公司配车摆在她面前。

examples.en: We jolted along rough wet roads through an endless banana plantation.
examples.zh: 我们沿崎岖潮湿的公路颠簸着驶过无边无际的香蕉种植园。

senses.meaning: 摇晃, 蹒跚, 交错, 摇摇摆摆

examples.en: He managed to stagger home.
examples.zh: 他好不容易才蹒跚着走回家。

examples.en: She staggered back a step.
examples.zh: 她踉跄着后退了一步。

examples.en: The old man staggered drunkenly to his feet.
examples.zh: 老汉醉醺醺地踉跄着站了起来。

senses.meaning: 咬, 啃, 啮, 使苦恼, 消耗, 折磨, 侵蚀

examples.en: Dexter gnawed his pen thoughtfully.
examples.zh: 德克斯特若有所思地咬着钢笔。

examples.en: A rat had gnawed a hole in the box.
examples.zh: 老鼠在箱子上咬了一个洞。

senses.meaning: 一口气喝干, 大口地喝

examples.en: She leaned on the door, but it wouldn’t budge.
examples.zh: 她靠在门上，但是门纹丝不动。

examples.en: The horse refused to budge an inch .
examples.zh: 那匹马寸步都不肯走。

examples.en: France is expected to detonate its first nuclear device in the next few days.
examples.zh: 预计法国将在未来几天内引爆它的第一个核装置。

examples.en: He lured her to his home and shot her with his father's gun.
examples.zh: 他把她诱骗到家里，然后用父亲的枪把她打死。

examples.en: Dawn and her boyfriend were cuddling on the sofa.
examples.zh: 唐和她的男朋友在沙发上搂搂抱抱。

senses.meaning: 拥挤, 卷缩, 草率从事, 挤作一团

examples.en: We lay huddled together for warmth.
examples.zh: 我们紧紧挤在一起取暖。

examples.en: All that pent-up frustration gushed out in a torrent of abuse.
examples.zh: 所有压抑着的失望与不快通过一阵痛骂全都发泄了出来。

examples.en: You have excelled yourself with the new exhibition.
examples.zh: 你新办的这次展览特别成功。

phrases.zh: v. 在……方面胜过；在……方面很擅长

examples.en: We shouldn't boggle at this opportunity to make a profit.
examples.zh: 对这个赚钱的机会我们不应犹豫。

examples.en: She vacillates between men twice her age and men younger than she.
examples.zh: 她在两个男人之间摇摆不定，一个年龄比她大一倍，一个比她小。

examples.en: The success in the Middle East redounds to his benefit.
examples.zh: 中东地区的该项成就对他有益。

examples.en: The spider must wait for prey to be ensnared on its web.
examples.zh: 蜘蛛一定要耐心等待，直到猎物被它的蛛网困住。

examples.en: He tries to counterfeit all the good things God offers you, aiming at our weakness in order to exploit our vulnerabilities and entice us into the darkness.
examples.zh: 他试图假冒所有上帝提供给我们的好事情，针对我们的弱点，以便开发我们的缺点，诱使我们进入黑暗。

examples.en: The higher rate would entice banks to tie up money they otherwise might lend to customers or other banks.
examples.zh: 更高的利率将诱使银行收回流动性，减少向客户或其它银行发放贷款的数量。

examples.en: She inveigles Paco into a plot to swindle Tania out of her savings.
examples.zh: 她把帕科诱骗进了一个骗取塔尼娅积蓄的阴谋里。

examples.en: The head lecturer was sacked for seducing female students.
examples.zh: 这个首席讲师因诱奸女学生而被解雇。

examples.en: Are you trying to seduce me?
examples.zh: 你是在勾引我吗？

examples.en: Today's events bespeak a bright future.
examples.zh: 今天的事件预示着一个美好的未来。

examples.en: The wall through Berlin was finally ruptured, prefiguring the reunification of Germany.
examples.zh: 柏林墙终于倒塌了，预示着德国的重新统一。

examples.en: strange events that portend disaster
examples.zh: 预示着灾难的奇怪事件

examples.en: She says the way the bill was passed bodes ill for democracy.
examples.zh: 她说议案通过的方式预示民主的恶运。

senses.meaning: 预示, 预言, 预兆, 预感

examples.en: can be, if I forebode aright, no power, short of the Divine mercy, to disclose, whether by uttered words, or by type or emblem, the secrets that may be buried with a human heart.
examples.zh: 如果我的预感不错的话，除去上天的仁慈，没有什么力量，无论是通过讲出来的语言或是任何形式的标志，能够揭示可能埋在一个人心里的秘密。

examples.en: Unfortunately, I am not able to prognosticate how everything will eventually shake out.
examples.zh: 不幸的是，我无法预言每件事的最终结果将会怎样。

examples.en: It has long been fashionable for Silicon Valley visionaries to prognosticate about the direction of technology.
examples.zh: 硅谷的想象者预测了技术的发展方向流行了好长时间。

examples.en: In such circumstances, governments must do all they can to create and engender trust among its nation’s constituents and institutions.
examples.zh: 在这种情况下，政府必须尽其所能在它的国家选民和公共机构之间创造和产生信任。

examples.en: Retrospectives on the process and working practices regularly capture the lessons learned by the project and engender a culture of continuous process improvement within the project.
examples.zh: 对过程和工作实践的回顾有规律地捕捉从项目中得到的经验，并在项目中造成一个持续的过程改进的文化。

examples.en: His mother summoned him, upbraided him, wept and prayed.
examples.zh: 他母亲把他叫来，责骂了他。然后母亲哭着做了祷告。

examples.en: "There's no call for talk like that," Mrs. Evans reproved him.
examples.zh: “没有必要说那种话，”埃文斯太太责备他道。

examples.en: She is quick to reproach anyone who doesn't live up to her own high standards.
examples.zh: 她动不动就指责达不到她高标准的人。

examples.en: He was officially censured for his handling of the situation.
examples.zh: 他因对这个情况处理不当而受到严厉批评。

examples.en: Any surplus was sold to augment their income.
examples.zh: 所有多余的东西被售卖一空来增加他们的收入。

examples.en: Computer courses continue to proliferate.
examples.zh: 计算机课程层出不穷。

examples.en: A businessman swindled investors out of millions of dollars.
examples.zh: 一位商人骗走了投资者数百万美元。

examples.en: The government had also incurred huge debts.
examples.zh: 政府也已承受了大笔债务。

examples.en: ...the Chernobyl disaster, which irradiated large parts of Europe.
examples.zh: ...辐射了欧洲大部的切尔诺贝利灾难。

examples.en: After a few minutes, he turned around and began to retrace his steps.
examples.zh: 几分钟后，他转身顺着原路返回。

senses.meaning: 折旧, (使)贬值, 降低, 贬低, 轻视

examples.en: New cars depreciate in value quickly.
examples.zh: 新车掉价很快。

examples.en: The associated cross-peak amplitude also appears to oscillate.
examples.zh: 相关的交叉峰的幅度也在振荡。

examples.en: Troops eventually quelled the unrest.
examples.zh: 部队最终镇压了动乱。

examples.en: Ella showed her the best places to go for a good buy, and taught her how to haggle with used furniture dealers.
examples.zh: 埃拉告诉她买便宜货的最佳去处，还教她怎样与二手家具商讨价还价。

examples.en: Mother is devoted to Dad although they squabble all the time.
examples.zh: 妈妈深爱着爸爸，虽然他们总是为琐事争吵。

examples.en: Police managed to subdue the angry crowd.
examples.zh: 警察设法控制住了愤怒的人群。

examples.en: Napoleon subdued much of Europe.
examples.zh: 拿破仑控制了大半个欧洲。

senses.meaning: 征募, 谋取(支持、赞助等), 应募, 赞助, 支持, 征召, 参军

examples.en: You must envisage realities.
examples.zh: 你必须正视现实。

examples.en: Police records attest to his long history of violence.
examples.zh: 警方记录证明他有长期的暴力史。

senses.meaning: 证明, 证实, 作证

examples.en: Mr Molto has agreed to testify at the trial.
examples.zh: 莫尔托先生已经同意出庭作证。

examples.en: Can you testify that you saw the defendant at the scene of the crime?
examples.zh: 你能作证你看到被告在犯罪现场吗？

examples.en: The aid will not be disbursed until next year.
examples.zh: 援助款项到明年才能拨出。

examples.en: ‘I’m not sure,’ he prevaricated.
examples.zh: “我不肯定。”他支支吾吾道。

examples.en: If SNS wants to press the meaning of its metaphrase " social network serves " for, the history should be quite long.
examples.zh: SNS假如要按它直译的意思“社会网络服务”来说，历史应该相当悠久。

examples.en: Chinese-English mutual translations are not only the metaphrase or paraphrase on language itself, but more focus on the culture background of the language.
examples.zh: 中英互译不仅仅是语言学层面上的直译或意译，而是更多地关注到语言背后的文化背景。

examples.en: A teenage mother was accused of smothering her 3-month-old daughter.
examples.zh: 一个少女妈妈被指控闷死自己三个月大的女儿。

examples.en: We hope that the military regime will desist from its acts of violence.
examples.zh: 我们希望军人政权停止暴力行为。

senses.meaning: 重步行走, 踏, 践, 践踏

examples.en: They put on their coats and tramped through the falling snow.
examples.zh: 他们穿上大衣，在落雪中脚步沉重地缓缓走着。

senses.meaning: 重读, 强调, 着重强调

examples.en: The photograph seemed to accentuate his large nose.
examples.zh: 照片似乎突出了他的大鼻子。

senses.meaning: 重述要点, 概括, 摘要

examples.en: Let's just recapitulate the essential points.
examples.zh: 让我们只概述一下基本要点吧。

examples.en: The trial has rekindled painful memories of the war.
examples.zh: 这场审判又唤起了人们对战争的痛苦回忆。

senses.meaning: 重整旗鼓, 给予新力量, (使)恢复健康, 力量, 决心, 集结

examples.en: After a shaky start, he rallied and won the title in style.
examples.zh: 虽然开局不顺，但他振作精神，最后漂亮地赢得了冠军。

examples.en: The Tokyo stock market rallied later in the day.
examples.zh: 当天晚些时候东京股市止跌回升。

phrases.zh: 赛前动员会，鼓舞士气的集会

examples.en: I shall be pleased to preside at your meetings.
examples.zh: 我很高兴主持你们的会议。

examples.en: Mr Justice Waller, presiding judge for the northeast
examples.zh: 沃勒法官，东北地区的首席法官

senses.meaning: 主管, 指挥, 管理, 监督

examples.en: Meese was to superintend the administration's entire domestic policy.
examples.zh: 米斯要监管政府的所有国内政策。

examples.en: an annotated edition of ‘Othello’
examples.zh: 《奥赛罗》的注释本

examples.en: A secretary transcribed the witnesses’ statements.
examples.zh: 一名书记员记录下证人的陈述。

examples.en: Henry averted his eyes as she undressed.
examples.zh: 她脱衣服的时候，亨利把目光转向别处。

senses.meaning: 转移, 归入, 提交

examples.en: She had finished the vegetables and was garnishing the roast.
examples.zh: 她已经做好了蔬菜，正给烤肉配饰菜。

examples.en: His watercolour designs adorn a wide range of books.
examples.zh: 他的水彩设计装饰着各种各样的书籍。

phrases.zh: 大黄蜂，熊蜂；桁洩网渔船

examples.en: And the LORD said unto Gideon, The people that are with thee are too many for me to give the Midianites into their hands, lest Israel vaunt themselves against me, saying, Mine own hand hath saved me.
examples.zh: 耶和华对基甸说，跟随你的人过多，我不能将米甸人交在他们手中，免得以色列人向我夸大，说，是我们自己的手救了我们。

examples.en: No matter how people vaunt an own great activity, they are usually just the outcomes of opportunity, rather than a great intention of result.
examples.zh: 不管人们怎样夸耀自己的伟大行动，它们常常只是机遇的产物，而非一个伟大意向的结果。

examples.en: And, this Valentines Day, pamper yourself.
examples.zh: 最后，这个情人节，纵容一下自己。

examples.en: o I can choose to pamper myself while I am in this unhappy place.
examples.zh: 当我不幸福时，我可以选择纵容一下自己。

examples.en: Most students rent rooms in their second year.
examples.zh: 大多数学生到二年级时租房居住。

examples.en: I’d rather have my own house than rent.
examples.zh: 我更想有自己的房子，不想租房。

examples.en: He died in 1874, heavily encumbered by debt.
examples.zh: 他于1874年去世，负债累累。

examples.en: Troops could be ferried in to interdict drug shipments.
examples.zh: 军队可以被渡运来阻断毒品运输。

senses.meaning: 阻隔, 阻塞, 遮断(道路、通道等)

examples.en: A small aircraft was obstructing the runway.
examples.zh: 一架小型飞机堵住了跑道。

examples.en: The column obstructed our view of the stage.
examples.zh: 柱子挡着，我们看不见舞台。

examples.en: Storms at sea impeded our progress.
examples.zh: 海上风暴阻碍了我们的航程。

examples.en: The company’s financial difficulties have deterred potential investors.
examples.zh: 该公司的财务困境令潜在的投资者望而却步。

examples.en: He had a considerable Elizabethan library to delve in.
examples.zh: 他拥有相当多的伊丽莎白时期的藏书供其钻研。

senses.meaning: 做姿势表达, 用手势谈话

examples.en: Jane gesticulated wildly and shouted ‘Stop! Stop!’
examples.zh: 简拼命打着手势，喊着“停下！停下！”

phrases.zh: 爱上…（fall in love with的过去式）

examples.en: Through faith he kept the passover, and the sprinkling of blood, lest he that destroyed the firstborn should touch them.
examples.zh: 他因着信，就守逾越节，（守或作立）行洒血的礼，免得那灭长子的临近以色列人。

examples.en: Scientists thought that most RNA in a cell was messenger RNA generated by protein-coding genes, RNA in ribosomes, or a sprinkling of other RNA elsewhere.
examples.zh: 大多数科学家认为，RNA在细胞的信使RNA的蛋白编码基因的核糖体，核糖核酸，或其他RNA洒在其他地方产生的。

examples.en: Elect according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, through sanctification of the Spirit, unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ: Grace unto you, and peace, be multiplied.
examples.zh: 就是照父神的先见被拣选，藉着圣灵得成圣洁，以致顺服耶稣基督，又蒙他血所洒的人。 愿恩惠平安，多多的加给你们。

examples.en: We guffawed at what Graham had written.
examples.zh: 我们对格雷厄姆写的东西狂笑不已。

examples.en: Sales have nosedived since January.
examples.zh: 自1月份以来销售额骤降。

senses.meaning: (道路等)分叉, (意见等)分歧, 脱离

examples.en: His interests increasingly diverged from those of his colleagues.
examples.zh: 他和同事们的兴趣越来越不同。

examples.en: Several months elapsed before his case was brought to trial.
examples.zh: 过了几个月他的案子才开审。

examples.en: The assignment must be completed within an overall elapsed time of one week.
examples.zh: 这项任务总的时限为一周，必须按时完成。

senses.meaning: (在灯下)用功, 深入研究, 专心著作
(在水中)挣扎, 困难地往前走, 踌躇, 发慌

examples.en: More and more firms are floundering because of the recession.
examples.zh: 由于经济衰退，越来越多的公司举步维艰。

senses.meaning: (逐步或暗中)侵占, 蚕食, 超出通常(或正常)界线

examples.en: The new institutions do not encroach on political power.
examples.zh: 这些新机构没有侵犯到政治权力。

examples.en: Left untreated, the abscesses suppurate ; the pus cannot escape from the body, and the malady spreads throughout the organism.
examples.zh: 将其置之脑后，而脓肿仍在化脓，其浓液不可能不侵入身体，这种疼痛（）布了整个有机体。

senses.meaning: <美口>夸张地作为, 表现感情

examples.en: Siskind encourages the children to emote to the music as they dance.
examples.zh: 西斯金德鼓励孩子们跳舞时要根据音乐表现出情感。

senses.meaning: 暗指, 影射, 间接提到

examples.en: With friends, she sometimes alluded to a feeling that she herself was to blame for her son's predicament.
examples.zh: 和朋友们一起时，她有时暗示她感到儿子的困境要怪她自己。

phrases.zh: 涉水（泥泞等）；费力地做完；艰难地通过
精神饱满地开始；猛烈攻击
vt. 插手，介入；猛烈攻击

senses.meaning: 备办食物, 满足(需要), 投合

examples.en: We cater to an exclusive clientele.
examples.zh: 我们满足一个特殊客户群的需求。

phrases.zh: 迎合；供应伙食；为…提供所需

examples.en: They stopped you as soon as you deviated from the script.
examples.zh: 你一偏离剧本，他们就会叫停。

senses.meaning: 变动, 波动, 涨落, 上下, 动摇

examples.en: Insect populations fluctuate wildly from year to year.
examples.zh: 昆虫的数量每年变化很大。

examples.en: At last her father relented and came to visit her.
examples.zh: 最后她父亲的态度软化，去看了她。

senses.meaning: 变小, 亏缺, 衰落, 退潮, 消逝, 呈下弦

examples.en: My enthusiasm for the project was waning.
examples.zh: 我对这个项目的热情逐渐减退了。

examples.en: The group’s influence had begun to wane by this time.
